title: VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an Interactive World
title_zh: VISTA：用于交互式世界推理的视觉增强框架
abstract_en: We show that multimodal models possess strong reasoning abilities and that an appropriate harness can unlock their potential to solve tasks across diverse interactive environments. We introduce VISTA, a visual harness that gives a general-purpose multimodal model long-horizon vision. VISTA allows the model to directly perceive the environment through visual observations and maintains a lossless visual memory that preserves past observations in their original form. The model can actively retrieve these observations and reorganize its visual input as it reasons. On ARC-AGI-3, VISTA improves Claude Opus 5.0's Relative Human Action Efficiency score from 40.68 to a perfect 100.00, with the model completing all 25 public games using 57.4% fewer actions than first-time human participants. VISTA's simple design also allows it to extend naturally to diverse visual environments with minimal adaptation. Across three additional benchmarks covering a diverse range of visual games and puzzles, it substantially outperforms baselines using the same underlying model with minimal harnesses. Our results highlight VISTA's potential as a general-purpose visual harness for advancing multimodal agents in complex visual environments.
abstract_zh: 论文提出 VISTA，一种面向通用多模态模型的视觉工具框架（visual harness），旨在增强模型在复杂交互环境中的长时程视觉推理能力。VISTA通过视觉观测直接感知环境，并维护保留原始内容的无损视觉记忆；模型可在推理过程中主动检索历史观测，并动态重组视觉输入。在 ARC-AGI-3 上，VISTA 将 Claude Opus 5.0 的 Relative Human Action Efficiency 从 40.68 提升至满分 100.00，并完成全部 25 个公开游戏，所用动作数比首次参与的人类用户少 57.4%。在另外三个涵盖多种视觉游戏与谜题的基准上，VISTA也显著优于使用同一基础模型和轻量工具框架的基线，且仅需极少适配，展现出作为通用视觉智能体框架的潜力。
key_points_zh: 提出 VISTA 视觉工具框架，通过直接视觉感知与无损视觉记忆支持长时程推理。
模型可主动检索历史视觉观测，并按当前推理需求重组视觉输入。
在 ARC-AGI-3 上，Claude Opus 5.0 的 Relative Human Action Efficiency 从 40.68 提升至 100.00。
VISTA 完成 ARC-AGI-3 全部 25 个公开游戏，动作数较首次参与的人类用户减少 57.4%。
在另外三个视觉游戏与谜题基准上显著超越基线，并能以较少适配扩展至不同环境。

llm_assessment.comment: A strong interactive visual-agent contribution that uses active retrieval and lossless visual memory to improve long-horizon reasoning and action efficiency across environments.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作通过主动检索和无损视觉记忆提升跨环境的长时程推理与行动效率，构成了较强的交互式视觉智能体贡献。
